import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def solve(prices, split_factors):
    # Adjust prices using the given split factors
    adjusted_prices = fin_skills.algorithms.adjust_prices(prices, split_factors)

    # Calculate the moving averages
    fast_ma = adjusted_prices.rolling(window=5).mean()
    slow_ma = adjusted_prices.rolling(window=20).mean()

    # Compute the signal
    signal = np.sign(fast_ma - slow_ma) / 4

    # Create a DataFrame of zeros with the same index and columns as prices
    weights = pd.DataFrame(0, index=prices.index, columns=prices.columns)

    # Set the weights based on the signal
    weights.iloc[1:] = signal.iloc[:-1]

    return weights
